function.name: Terrain_ActorCollisionNoOpHook
function.body: The complete function body is one RTS instruction.
function.surrounding_contract: Actor_TerrainCollisionLoop calls this entry after loading a terrain-row word and shifting it right once; immediately afterward it indexes the terrain behavior table and publishes the selected behavior byte.

comparison: This hook is distinct from Terrain_ResolverNoOpReturn at 0x001ADB34 and Terrain_TemporaryLookupHelper at 0x001ADB36; those addresses have separate call sites and bodies.
conclusion: The entry is an intentional RTS-only actor terrain-collision hook. It does not perform a hidden terrain lookup or modify actor state.
